title: A 3D Cell Culture Model Identifies Wnt/β‐Catenin Mediated Inhibition of p53 as a Critical Step during Human Hepatocyte Regeneration

evidence_spans.quote: a 3D spheroid model of PHH is established to study hepatocyte regeneration

scope_reviewer.uncertainty_reason: The report labels PAI1 as senescence-inducing but analyzes hepatocyte regeneration and proliferation without explicitly measuring, inducing, reversing, or comparing a senescent state. It uses only a generic multi-omics label and does not identify the currently used molecular layers.
scope_reviewer.concise_rationale: This is an empirical study in primary human hepatocytes. Aging relevance is unresolved under the senescence-associated target rule; named multi-omics layers are not supplied.

causal_design_reviewer.exposure_or_intervention: Activation of Wnt signaling through external cues
causal_design_reviewer.outcome: p53 and PAI1 inhibition and primary human hepatocyte proliferation
causal_design_reviewer.estimand_or_contrast: Wnt activation through external cues was sufficient to inhibit p53/PAI1 and drive proliferation of >50% of PHH

evidence_spans.quote: Functional validations reveal that activation of Wnt signaling through external cues
sufficient to inhibit p53 and its proliferative senescence-inducing target PAI1 (SERPINE1) and drive proliferation of >50% of all PHH
activation of Wnt signaling through external cues alone is sufficient

causal_design_reviewer.concise_rationale: The report applies an external Wnt-signaling manipulation and reports its effects on p53/PAI1 and hepatocyte proliferation.

adjudication.uncertainty_reason: The senescence reference characterizes PAI1, while the analyzed outcome is hepatocyte regeneration/proliferation; no senescent state is explicitly measured, induced, reversed, or compared. The abstract also does not specify the molecular layers used.
adjudication.concise_rationale: This is an empirical human-hepatocyte regeneration study. Aging relevance is unresolved under the senescence-target boundary rule, so the Wnt perturbation does not establish a causal design applied to an eligible aging construct at title/abstract stage.
